responses.fb_other:
I'm not sure if I spent enough time doing the graph annotations, it would have been helpful if there was a clock to show how much time we were expected to complete the survey, since we were allowed to opt-out, I may have finished a little early. 

My biggest frustration with the annotation tool was that the zoom feature was a little too sensitive, and I could only zoom all the way in or all the way out unless I was very careful with it. Also, dragging the chart to pan it from side to side got taxing, it would have been easier if there was a way to click the timeline to move the chart, or use the arrow keys to pan it or something else like that.

responses.demo_timeseries: Yes, sometimes (e.g., occasional use at work/research)
responses.demo_ai_experience:
I use Claude almost daily, for general research, creative projects (music, graphics) or for coding work. I've been using Claude since the beginning of the year, I was a moderately serious ChatGPT user since October 2023. With Claude, I've done some subagent work in code generation, although nothing too serious (I try not to push it so far that I have to pay for extra tokens).

I also make visual art with Stable Diffusion and I've done some customization with my setup, including a little bit of my own coding in Python. I've also done a little exploratory work with neural nets in audio / music.
